note: Hand-curated decode of the 0xF0 configuration/provisioning worker 0xa39a and its 7-entry sub-dispatch. Code addresses are payload offsets; AUIPC-derived absolute addresses include the linked base 0x8000. ABI names come from OpenWCH commit 64be9554615df522899579633530fd234d685682, EVT/EXAM/BLE/LIB/wchble_rom.h, matching the embedded CH32V20x_BLE_LIB_V1.3 string. Confidence: Confirmed unless marked Correlated.

dispatch.selector: payload[0] (first byte after the validated header), range 1..7
dispatch.stored_handle: 0xa39e: sh a0 -> 0x2000bff6 (16-bit request/handle latched before dispatch)

shared_primitives.0x8a54: If the pointer at 0x2000bff8 is nonzero, calls GAPRole_TerminateLink at resident slot 0x4017c with the object's 16-bit connection handle at +0x20, deallocates the object through slot 0x40068, then clears 0x2000bff8.
shared_primitives.0x8f46: Tail-calls tmos_set_event at resident slot 0x40050 with task ID from 0x2000bff0 and event bit 4.
shared_primitives.0x8dec: Allocates 0x88 bytes via tmos_msg_allocate at resident slot 0x40070, populates and passes the message to 0xbab8, then deallocates it through slot 0x40068.
shared_primitives.0x4003c: tmos_memcmp(src1, src2, 6), whose Boolean result is TRUE when the six-byte fields are equal.
shared_primitives.0x40040: tmos_isbufset(record+3, 0, 6), used during three-record table scans.
shared_primitives.0x40050: tmos_set_event(task_id, event), called by local helper 0x8f46.
shared_primitives.0x40068: tmos_msg_deallocate, called with an object or buffer pointer by 0x8a54 and 0x8dec.
shared_primitives.0x4017c: GAPRole_TerminateLink, called with a 16-bit connection handle by 0x8a54 and selector 7.

sub_handlers.summary: Calls 0x8a54 to terminate/deallocate any object at 0x2000bff8, writes 1 to RAM bytes 0x2000bff4 and 0x2000bffc, then tail-jumps to 0x8ac0.
Calls 0x8a54, clears RAM bytes 0x2000bff4 and 0x2000bffc, then 0x8f46 sets event bit 4 for the task ID at 0x2000bff0.
No-op / epilogue: restores callee-saved registers and returns (shared function tail). Selector 3 and 6 both land here, i.e. reserved/unused subcodes.
Restores the stack frame and tail-jumps to 0x8dec, which allocates, populates, passes, and deallocates a 0x88-byte message. The higher-level effect remains unresolved.

Three-record table scan gated on selector-arg == 0x1F. Clears RAM byte 0x2000bff4, then scans the array whose pointer is stored at gp+0x7c using 43-byte entries; tmos_isbufset at resident slot 0x40040 tests whether each 6-byte field at entry+3 is all zero.
evidence: 0xa45c..0xa474: load array pointer from gp+0x7c; call tmos_isbufset(entry+3,0,6); stride 0x2B; exclusive offset limit 0x81

sub_handlers.summary: Second three-record table operation gated on selector-arg == 7. Advances the payload pointer by 2, clears RAM byte 0x2000bff4, then compares six payload bytes against entry+3 through tmos_memcmp at resident slot 0x4003c. The path also calls GAPRole_TerminateLink for matching connection records; its complete mutation/report behavior is not yet resolved.
evidence: 0xa50e..0xa51e: load array pointer; call resident slot 0x4003c with a0=entry+3,a1=payload+2,a2=6

three_record_table.operations: selector 5 calls tmos_isbufset(entry+3,0,6); selector 7 compares entry+3 with payload+2 via tmos_memcmp
three_record_table.note: The table's peer/bond interpretation is Correlated only; the field meaning, full record layout, and complete selector 5/7 effects remain unresolved.
